content: Klaviyo/Mailchimp/Braze all support per-profile GDPR/CCPA export: Klaviyo exports complete profile data as CSV via segment-of-one export (all subscription statuses included); Mailchimp exports per-contact CSV via Export Contacts + has a formal DSAR intake page; Braze exposes per-user-profile export via REST API/SDK covering attributes and custom events, but explicitly cannot delete/export individual behavioral events selectively - only whole-profile deletion. Third-party privacy-ops tools (DataGrail, TrustWorks) integrate with these platforms to automate DSR fulfillment across systems. Customer.io specifics not found in search.
